dtk.text: Atarka arrives with her storms, which melt the Qal Sisma glaciers, and she devours most of the shamans of the former Temur clan, so the surviving shamans warn each other secretly through the Wide Whisper as her purge begins.
She also conquers Qadat, the Fire Rim, winning over its efreet with a promise to spread the glory of fire to all the world.

Her clan feeds her tribute of meat, as Yasova feeds her mammoth carcasses to save the Temur from attack and Surrak leads a hunt for an enormous krushok and delivers the offering at Ayagor, saying that if she spares them there will be more.
Rebellions grow under Atarka's cruel rule, and surviving whisperers emerge from hiding to galvanize them until the rebels and whisperers combine forces to defeat Atarka and the other dragonlords.

m19.text: Atarka killed her own mother for being a whisperer, as Naiva tells Tae Jin.

When a dragon tempest passes over the camp, Atarka arrives, finds her dead broodling and drives the newborn dragons back into the storm, then lands between the hunting band and the shelter and eats Darka.

Yasova tells her that Ojutai's kin killed her broodling and that the hunters killed the outsider as a feast, but Atarka spots Tae Jin as an outsider who smells of Ojutai, and she agrees to hear a story while she eats before deciding his fate.
Atarka declares that there is only one law, to eat, and she spares Tae Jin before flying off.
